card.name: Last word before an abbreviation in parentheses
card.fires_on: The last word of a multi-word medical term, right before its abbreviation appears in parentheses, such as (CNS), (ROI) or (BMI). Most often the 'ous' of Central Nervous System.

modes.label: Central Nervous System
modes.description: The 'ous' or 'nervous' in the phrase before (CNS) in opioid and benzodiazepine interaction text.

modes.label: Other spelled-out terms
modes.description: The last or next-to-last word of another term whose abbreviation follows.
